blazers.pulse: Saturday stung: Portland clawed back from 26 down to lead the Knicks with 3.4 seconds left, then Mikal Bridges hit a buzzer three for a 97-96 Knicks win. Slow starts have dogged the last few road games, and the trip has worn everyone down.
storylines: Lost 97-96 at New York on a Bridges three at the horn after a 26-point comeback
Scoot Henderson had a rough night vs. the Knicks: 1-for-8, 3 points, 3 turnovers
Slow starts in the last three games, all on the road (Sean Highkin via Hoops Rumors)
Six-game road trip wraps tonight (Mon) at Philadelphia

timbers.pulse: Game 1 in Frisco went badly: FC Dallas won 3-0, with Joaquín Valiente scoring twice in two minutes early in the second half. Portland now has to win at Providence Park to keep the season alive.
storylines: Lost Game 1 of the best-of-3 Round One series 3-0 at FC Dallas (Sat Nov 21)
Valiente scored in the 53rd and 55th minutes; Sam Sarver added one in stoppage time
Game 2 is Saturday, Nov 28 at Providence Park
A Game 3 would be Dec 5 if Portland evens the series

f1.pulse: Las Vegas was a slipstream thriller: Max Verstappen fell behind both McLarens heading into the last lap and still won by 0.6s over Lando Norris. Verstappen called it something he'd never seen in F1, while Kimi Antonelli's title lead stays huge.
storylines: Verstappen wins Las Vegas; Norris and Piastri complete the podium for McLaren
Antonelli leads the drivers' title on 402 points, 98 clear of Verstappen
George Russell hit the wall late and dropped to ninth; Hamilton jumps to third in the standings
Mercedes lead the constructors on 666; McLaren cut Red Bull's lead for third to nine points

ducks.pulse: Oregon rolled Michigan State 45-7 on Friday night for a fourth straight win. Now it all rides on the rivalry game: beat Washington and the Big Ten title game and playoff hopes stay alive.
storylines: Beat Michigan State 45-7 in East Lansing (Fri Nov 20)
At 8-3 (6-2 Big Ten), the Ducks need a win to stay in the Big Ten title and playoff hunt
Washington (7-4) is playing spoiler
Next game: Saturday, Nov 28 vs. Washington at Autzen, 4:30 PM PT on NBC

niners.pulse: Sunday night in Mexico City was a rout: the Niners beat the Vikings 35-10 to move to 9-1 and hold the NFC's No. 1 seed. Brock Purdy carved up the league's stingiest defense and the MVP talk is getting louder.
storylines: Beat Minnesota 35-10 in Mexico City; now 9-1 and the NFC's top seed
Purdy: 21 of 26, 255 yards, 3 TDs; Kittle caught two TDs and Ji'Ayir Brown had a pick-six
Mike Evans was active after a month out with Achilles tendinitis; Dre Greenlaw was inactive
Next game: Sunday, Nov 29 vs. Seattle at Levi's Stadium, 1:25 PM PT on FOX
